description: This file defines data models for a book detail including chapters and bookmarks, used in a book reader application. It contains class definitions, JSON serialization methods, and references to external model classes.

classes.name: BookDetail
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a book, including metadata, chapters, and bookmarks.

classes.name: Chapter
classes.description: Represents a chapter of a book with its id, title, index, and href.

methods.name: BookDetail.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a BookDetail instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: BookDetail.toJson
methods.description: Converts a BookDetail instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: Chapter.fromManifestJson
methods.description: Creates a Chapter instance from JSON data in the manifest, with index and JSON map.

methods.name: Chapter.toJson
methods.description: Serializes a Chapter instance into JSON format.
